map.依据《民法典》继承编，输入遗嘱类型（自书、代书、打印等），快速判断该遗嘱对见证人: Per the Civil Code's succession provisions, enter the will type (handwritten, attested, printed, etc.) to quickly judge witness qualification requirements and who cannot serve, aiding proper will execution.
map.判断某类遗嘱是否需要见证人，以及拟选见证人是否具备资格。: Judge whether a will type needs witnesses and whether the chosen witness qualifies.
map.排除无/限制民事行为能力人、继承人、受遗赠人及其近亲属、有利害关系人。: Exclude persons with no/limited capacity, heirs, legatees and close relatives, and interested parties.
map.自书遗嘱与公证遗嘱无需见证人。: Handwritten and notarized wills need no witnesses.
map.：代书遗嘱由继承人担任见证人 → 该见证人不合格，遗嘱可能因见证人瑕疵被认定无效: : Attested will with an heir as witness → that witness is unqualified; the will may be void for witness defect; choose two unrelated persons with full capacity instead.
map.：自书遗嘱（亲笔书写签名注日期）、公证遗嘱无需见证人；打印/代书/录音录像/口头: : Handwritten (personally written, signed, dated) and notarized wills need no witness; printed/attested/audio-video/oral wills require two or more qualified witnesses.
map.，涉及具体争议请以证据与司法机关认定为准，必要时咨询执业律师。: , and for specific disputes rely on evidence and judicial determination; consult a licensed attorney when necessary.
map.无民事行为能力人或限制民事行为能力人、继承人、受遗赠人，以及与他们有利害关系的人: Persons with no/limited capacity, heirs, legatees, and those with an interest (e.g., close relatives, creditors/debtors, partners) may not serve.
map.代书、打印、录音录像、口头遗嘱均需两名以上见证人，且须全程在场并签章（口头遗嘱限: Attested, printed, audio-video, and oral wills all need two or more witnesses present throughout and signing (oral will only in emergencies).
